tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the mvp project knowledge: plan and decisions (1_mvp_prompt), infra and runbooks (1_mvp_infra), SDLC/factory (1_mvp_sdlc), app README/CONTEXT/CHANGELOG/architecture maps (1_mvp_pilot_be, 1_mvp_pilot_fe). Returns up to k (1..20) files, best chunk each, with repo, path, commit_sha and a GitHub url to cite. repo narrows the search to one of those repos.
